messages:
Claire Park: Quick sync — Legal wants clarity on how SLA credits show up in packaging. Do we apply credits at the tier level, or as a separate "addon SLA" line item?
Devon Liu: My gut: separate addon so enterprise customers see a distinct contractable SLA. Makes billing + reporting cleaner.
Marta Gómez: +1 for visibility, but that adds complexity for small tiers. We need launch criteria: must support automatic credit calc and invoice line item.
Ravi Patel: What are the ops implications? If it's per-addon, we need per-route SLO tracking and a mapping to billing keys. Can we reuse existing metrics?
ops-bot: deploy-billing-pipeline v2 scheduled for 2026-08-12 — includes per-route metering tags: env, model, route_id, customer_commit_id.
Devon Liu: Great, that pipeline helps. For launch we should require: (1) per-route SLOs exposed, (2) automated credit calc <= 24h, (3) billing line item available in UI + export.
Claire Park: Customers asking for pro-rated credits when rolling upgrades happen. Do we accept partial-period credits?
Marta Gómez: Sales says customers expect pro-rate for mid-month commit changes; legal prefers calendar-period buckets to limit exposure. Tradeoff: customer experience vs revenue simplicity.
Ravi Patel: Proposal: support pro-rate for changes that increase committed capacity (goodwill), but deny pro-rate for decreases until next billing cycle unless a formal exception. That reduces abuse.
Devon Liu: Also need to decide if credits count against on-demand usage or are separate. I suggest separate credit ledger to avoid double-dipping in analytics.
Marta Gómez: Launch gating checklist for PM + Sales: must have clear contract language, UI wording, and examples in T&Cs. Also need a migration path for existing reserved customers.
Claire Park: Timeline? If we target GA with Dedicated customers first, we can pilot the addon SLA ledger and tweak wording. Pilot window 6 weeks after billing-pipeline v2.
Ravi Patel: Dev work estimate: 3 sprints for metering + ledger + invoice line item. Ops has 2 weeks for rollout playbook.
Marta Gómez: OK — I'll draft contract language and a short FAQ for Sales. Can someone add a small table of allowed credit scenarios in the PRD?
Devon Liu: I'll add it. Table will include: trigger, eligible customers, pro-rate allowed, manual-override policy.
Claire Park: Thanks — action items: @Devon add table to PRD, @Marta draft legal wording & FAQ, @Ravi schedule ops runbook with deploy dates. We'll reconvene after pipeline deploy. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: reminder: billing-pipeline v2 deploy window 2026-08-12 02:00 UTC — expect 15m downtime for export jobs (non-customer impacting).
